title: A font recreated from photographs of classic Commodore 64 keycaps
summary: A developer photographed actual Commodore 64 keyboard keycaps and meticulously recreated the classic pixel font from those photographs, making it available as an open-source digital font for modern use.
problem_solved: Recreating authentic, pixel-perfect replicas of the classic Commodore 64 font that capture the original hardware's distinctive character
why_valuable: Preserves computing history by digitizing a beloved retro font with genuine physical origins, perfect for nostalgia-driven projects and retro gaming aesthetics
